# runzero_export_token (Resource)

Manages a RunZero export token.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String) The organization ID for this export token.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) A comment for the export token.
- `rotate` (String) Arbitrary keeper value. Changing it rotates the export token.

### Read-Only

- `counter` (Number) Total usage counter.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the export token was created.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the export token.
- `last_used_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the token was last used.
- `last_used_by` (String) Identifier of the last user of the token.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The export token value.
